description: This is an HTML source file that represents the front-end interface for a database visualizer web application. It includes structure, styles, and embedded JavaScript logic for browsing databases, tables, and viewing data with dynamic fetching, rendering, and user interactions.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of available databases.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by re-fetching the data.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Handles expanding/collapsing database entries and loading associated tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML to display tabular data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates table cell HTML, handling different data types and expand/collapse functionality.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for large data or objects.
